run_pump_generate_code: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
parse_pump_ast: parse a Pump source text string into an abstract syntax tree using ParseToAST
convert_pump_source: convert Pump meta-programming source text into generated C++ code using ConvertFromPumpSource
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize Pump source text into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters using BeautifyCode
